reason: The hypothesis directly restates the observation from P2 that a Cu-rich phase melts and spreads on the surface of CoCrCu buttons before the bulk, and combines it with the known tendency for Cu segregation in CrFeCoNiCu nanoparticles (P15) and the general principle that low-melting elements segregate (P11, P12). It proposes no new mechanism, material, or regime beyond what these passages already report or imply, and the falsification test is a straightforward extension of the same idea.
copied_elements: Cu segregation due to low melting point (P11, P12)
Cu segregation observed in CrFeCoNiCu nanoparticles (P15)
in-situ neutron imaging of melting (P1, P2)
